intro: Technology, manufacturing, and research sectors were the primary targets of remote code execution attacks between April 12 and May 20, 2026, with 32 articles covering the tag. The threat actor PhantomCore was observed, while critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2025-54987, CVE-2026-22679, CVE-2026-31251, CVE-2026-45033, and CVE-2026-4883, each with a CVSS score of 9.8, were widely exploited. The severity mix comprised 20 critical, 11 high, and 1 medium incident, with significant impacts reported across Asia, China, and Russia.
